nodes.label: Apple Touch Icon (Laravel Logo)
nodes.rationale: Default Laravel framework logo (red isometric outline of stacked cubes forming an L shape) used as the iOS home-screen touch icon; indicates the app is scaffolded from a Laravel starter and the icon has not yet been replaced with Cake Studio branding.

nodes.label: Laravel Logo Mark
nodes.rationale: The path depicts the Laravel framework's isometric stacked-cube/box outline mark, filled with Laravel's brand red #FF2D20.

nodes.label: Site Favicon (favicon.svg)
nodes.rationale: Default browser-tab icon shipped in the public directory; a 166x166 single-path SVG in Laravel red (#FF2D20), left as the framework's scaffold default rather than custom Cake Studio branding.
